1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 找了到：找到了，The resultative complement 到 must follow the verb directly, and 了 comes after the complete verb-result compound. 找到 means “to find,” while 找 means “to look for.”

items.reason: The aspect marker must follow the verb-result compound: 找到了, not 找了到.
